title: Hand Prosthesis Usability and Performance
official: Validation of a Multi-articulating Hand Prosthesis
summary: This study asks individuals with upper limb absence to use a new hand prosthesis, and compare it's performance to their own hand prosthesis
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Multi-articulating hand experience
* At least 18 years old
* Transradial, acquired amputation or congenital upper limb absence
* Unilateral upper limb absence preferred Good socket comfort in own prosthesis (\>/= 6 on Hanspal socket comfort score)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Any health conditions that pose a risk to participation in study events (in the opinion of the Investigator), e.g. Visual impairment; Cognitive impairment
* Cognitively unable to provide informed consent or comply with the study procedures
